notes.title: Update 1.5.2 with New Features!
notes.notes:
Our latest update for Necroking is here, bringing fresh content and gameplay enhancements! Make sure to download the latest version to explore these new features. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897194/4c0e44b98ffd726ac96055780f3ee11bea74dec6.png

List of Changes: 

 Added enhanced versions of select units, available via crafting at the Obelisk using Stars. Upgrade your team and unleash new power! 
 Added 4x-speed option for battle animations. This feature can be activated through Settings for a faster-paced experience. 
 Added simplified animation mode to further speed up combat. This option can also be toggled in Settings. 
 Balance Adjustments: Various minor tweaks to improve gameplay balance. 

We hope you enjoy the new content and updates! Keep the feedback coming as we continue to enhance Necroking for you. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: Update 1.4.4 with New Content
notes.notes:
The latest update, including a small pack of new content and several bug fixes, is here! Please make sure you have the latest version (1.4.4) of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897194/c0681e928fb54e949012bbd75dce16c12249efb4.jpg

List of Changes: 


 Added a new Halloween-themed biome and boss. The new biome unlocks once the player unlocks the Swamp biome. If the player has already completed the game, starting a new run will grant access. 
 Added new units and single-use cards. 
 Added new soundtracks for various biomes. 
 Added two new achievements. 
 Fixed an issue with the save system to prevent conflicts with antivirus software for some users. 


Enjoy the new content and Happy Halloween! 🎃 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: Update 1.3.7 with a new mode
notes.notes:
We’re excited to roll out the Necroking update with a new game mode and several improvements. Please ensure you have the latest version (1.3.7) of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897194/5cd184fcad369dd0082d890b32b8d270190528c9.jpg

List of Changes: 


 Added a new ‘Strategy’ mode. In this mode, most cards added to your deck will burn away permanently after each battle, and you’ll need to rebuild your deck from your reserves after every fight. You must manage your deck carefully to make it through the entire run. The mode unlocks after defeating the final form of the King. 
 Added 4 new achievements.  
 Changed controls for gamepad/Steam Deck during battles. Instead of holding a button for several seconds to draw cards, you now just double-tap the same button. 
 Made some minor UI improvements. 

Thanks for playing Necroking! Enjoy the new mode, and keep the feedback coming! Stay tuned for more updates.

notes.title: Update 1.2.6 with controller support
notes.notes:
We’re excited to bring you a small but anticipated update, as we’ve finally added full controller support to Necroking! Please ensure you have the latest version (1.2.6) of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897194/47fca348ac0fcefa75e02902439c2b270f3e5a67.jpg

List of сhanges: 

 Added full controller support (PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo). 
 Added full compatibility for Steam Deck and other portable gaming systems. You can now fully enjoy Necroking using all of its controls - not just the trackpads like before.
 Fixed an issue with one of the Mage Towers not generating properly. 
 Fixed an issue with Necroking’s health not saving correctly after escaping from battle. 

Thanks for playing Necroking! Enjoy the new features, and stay tuned for more updates! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: Small Content Update 1.1.2
notes.notes:
We’re excited to bring you an update with important improvements to save files and exciting new content! Please ensure you have the latest version (1.1.2) of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897194/18703961d56520957de15032ad5004446ee3f310.jpg

List of Changes: 

 Added a new mini-biome. The new biome features fresh tiles, including wave-based enemy battles and a new boss tile. It has a 50% chance of replacing the Mushroom biome. 
 Added new units: Gunner, Walking Coffin, Burning Skull. 
 Changed the save system. We’ve updated the save file location to fix issues with OneDrive and other cloud services. The new save directory is now located at: AppData/LocalLow/KORO GAMES/Necroking instead of the old location Documents/KORO GAMES/Necroking. 
The transfer happens automatically. If you use Steam Cloud, please select the latest local save after the transfer. Also, the game now automatically creates backup saves when you enter battle or the main menu. 

Thanks for playing Necroking! Enjoy the new content, share your thoughts, and stay tuned for future updates! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: Update 1.0.7 and Community Items!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to bring you a new patch with bug fixes, balance changes, and several improvements. Please ensure you have the latest version (1.0.7) of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897194/bfb6eea05fd488859f5b3b362fe05e727c4b3554.jpg

List of changes: 

 Reverted the Slingshot Skeleton to its original stats and abilities. 
 Changed the ability of the Demon unit. It now gains +3 strength for each hit on the Totem, with the maximum possible strength increased to 17. 
 Increased the strength of the Spider Priest and Spider Wizard by 1. 
 Reduced the mana cost of the Spider Wizard from 10 to 5. 
 Reduced the sound volume for the Totem. 
 Reduced the sound volume for the Handful of Skulls. 

Also, we're excited to let you know that community items are now available, including 3 profile backgrounds and 5 emoticons.

Thanks for your continued support! Stay tuned for future updates, and don’t forget to share your feedback and leave a review.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: Major Balance Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
We’re exited to release another patch for Necroking, focused on addressing bugs and making key balance adjustments. Please ensure you have the latest version (1.0.5) of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897194/cdccac4bb81ce93ba88e445f1bada555351e0ad8.jpg

List of balance changes: 

 Increased the difficulty of the King. 
 Increased the chance of Mound (meta shop) appearing on the map. 
 Reduced the percentage of lost units when fleeing. 
 Cultist: Maximum strength reduced from 10 to 7; Rune cost increased from 1 to 4. 
 Rider: Strength set to 5; a new ability grants +2 strength when moving forward and –2 strength when moving backward. 
 Vampire: Strength reduced from 9 to 8, soul cost increased from 6 to 7. 
 Scapegoat: Mana cost increased from 2 to 6; added a new ability that makes it a priority target for attacks. 
 Spider Priest: Card draw per turn increased from +1 to +3. 
 Cocoon: Gained a reusable ability. 
 Spider Prince: Gained an attack ability. 
 Slingshot Skeleton: Strength reduced from 2 to 1; now gains a movement ability, allowing it to move to the next zone if there are no enemies in either its current zone or the next one. 
 Wizard: Strength reduced from 8 to 7. 
 Healer: Mana cost reduced from 10 to 7; soul cost reduced from 2 to 1. 
 Summoner: Mana cost reduced from 10 to 7. 
 Swamp Spirit: Starting mana cost increased from 20 to 40. 
 Soul Thief: Treasure cost increased from 140 to 160; crafting recipe changed to “Swordsman + Restless Ghost + Soul Orb” (was “Swordsman + Soul Orb”). 
 Summoner Mage: Strength increased from 2 to 8. 
 Demon: Strength gained from Soul Totem increased from +1 to +2; maximum boost reduced from 15 to 14; spawn zones expanded from 1 and 2 to 1, 2, and 3. 
 Soul Totem: Strength increased from 1 to 5; soul cost reduced from 2 to 1; spawn zones adjusted from 1, 2, 3, and 4 to 1, 2, and 3. 
 Soul Bomb: Damage increased from 3 to 5. 

Other changes: 

 Fixed an issue with the dialogue window freezing after completing quests. 
 Removed some unused settings from the game. 

Thanks for playing Necroking! More updates are on the way, leave feedback and stay tuned. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: First Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
We’re excited to bring you the first patch for Necroking, focused on balancing gameplay and enhancing the overall player experience. Please ensure you have the latest version (1.0.4) of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897194/6d677cc0332c9ea52246bd1d895a20dd42f30fe5.jpg

List of changes: 

 Increased starting bones from 14 to 20 in expedition mode and from 12 to 15 in balanced mode. 
 Improved targeting logic for ranged units. They now have the same attack priority as melee units. 
 Improved the deckbuilding tutorial. 
 Changed the Mad Scientist’s behavior. He no longer has the skill that makes him the last to be attacked and will now actively protect his creations in combat. 
 Changed the text when starting a new run. It no longer incorrectly mentions save loss and now accurately reflects the intended meaning. 
 Added a new visual and text notification when the player lacks supplies for an escape attempt. 
 Added new VFX to indicate when the player doesn’t have enough cards for battle. 
 Fixed an issue with infinite loading in the game. 
 Fixed an issue with battles hanging. 
 Fixed misspellings in tooltips. 

We also want to share our plans for future updates: 

 Bug fixes and both major and minor improvements. 
 Controller support (PS, Xbox, Nintendo). 
 Steam Deck verification. We plan to receive full Steam Deck full compatibility check mark after adding controller support. For now, you can play Necroking on Steam Deck using the trackpads. 
 New mini-biome and units. 
 New Game+ mode. 

Thank you for your feedback and support as we continue to improve Necroking! Stay tuned for more updates and exciting content coming soon. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking

notes.title: Release Date Reveal!
notes.notes:
The world teeters on the brink of madness, and the Master of Necromancy shall rise to plunge it into darkness. 

Necroking is coming September 4th for Windows & MacOS! 

Prepare to don the crown of death and wield unspeakable power as you set forth on a journey to conquer a world desecrated by life itself. The fate of the world is in your hands, and the power of necromancy will guide your every move. 

[previewyoutube=KZB2Jc8-aDE;full][/previewyoutube]

What awaits you in the Necroking: 


 4 diverse biomes: each with its own deadly challenges and unique bosses. 
 3 distinct endings: each determined by your choices and actions throughout the game. 
 New Game Plus mode: unlock even greater challenges and replayability. 
 Unit Creation Book: discover and experiment with powerful recipes to craft your undead minions. 
 Cairn: use runes to unlock new types of units. 
 Demonic Casino: test your luck in the high-risk, high-reward casino. 
 King's Secret: journey with the King through the story and uncover what he is hiding 

Also, single-use cards, the Prison Cart, meta currency, new types of units, and more features will be available in the release version of Necroking on September 4th! 

Stay tuned — join our Discord server and wishlist Necroking so you don’t miss when the journey begins: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/
